current_boundaries.fact: Whole-source converted audition creates fresh converter per cursor, seeks by source-zero preroll, consumes application-selected8192-input blocks, forces last positive block final, loops past zero-produced blocks, then applies separate gain/ring/callback adapter.
current_boundaries.implication: These explicit existing policies do not implement retained native AudioAccessor read/seek state.

current_boundaries.fact: Direct equal-rate immutable-memory read is addressed by absolute native plans; gain follows copy. Cursor publishes only after the complete output block succeeds.
current_boundaries.implication: Keep this admission while introducing an independently verified accessor; do not replace requested output windows with whole-source conversion.

current_boundaries.fact: Placed path replays preserved source clock and uses explicit source-rate context, while other conversion modes remain complete/zero-origin.
current_boundaries.implication: Frozen import profiles and original placement/processing gates must remain intact. Different reader/accessor/project rates need explicit binding.

current_boundaries.fact: One serialized producer with bounded pending AV buffers; cancellation synchronizes before stopping/detaching, stale callbacks use generations. Each play currently creates a new cursor.
current_boundaries.implication: Reuse isolation/cancellation, but specify accessor lifetime separately from a UI play session; asynchronous callbacks must never mutate the same converter concurrently.

recommended_architecture.recommendation: Keep source/report/media proof plus original format descriptor and exact decoded PCM. A Float32 storage representation must not erase the original source-format dispatch or intermediate quantization requirements.
Retain separately rounded descriptor start/end/offset and reader datum period; distinguish file/source rate, accessor output rate, builder rate, timeline period and final device rate.

Own source position, first-budget flag, converter handle/history/counters, backend read position and format/configuration. Keep per-owner identity/lifetime explicit; neither per-file sharing nor per-block recreation is justified without the native cache binding.

Map through binary32 source/output ratio, store source position, retain converter and first flag. Keep actual returned mapped position distinct from requested output position; do not round or preroll it into apparent equality.

Budget from the requested output count; preserve old first flag then clear it before budget0/read-error paths. Underlying seek must exactly match before this phase. Advance accessor source position only by successful actual source read count; return the converter-produced count.

Bind the selected native format branch before choosing order. Downsample of actual PCM24 may quantize back to24 before later work; upsample may follow format/gain. Unity-only initial admission avoids unproved gain commutation.

Timeline success requires exactly the requested count. No automatic fill/read-until-full repair. Assemble an application block privately; if a nonrollback native/backend operation fails, stop/discard the accessor session instead of pretending converter state rolled back.

A native read retry repeats read with unchanged request and without seek/reset. UI reconfiguration/revalidation can remain a declared fresh session policy until hosted seek/cache lifetime is bound. Cancellation destroys ownership only after the serial producer barrier.

concrete_native_controls.discriminates: Double-ratio mapping would produce44100; do not force the returned position to equal request.

concrete_native_controls.case: Read a nonzero impulse/ramp block, seek forward/backward/same position, then read with the same converter. Compare against independently replayed retained state and deliberately fresh-reset history.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Seek changes position only; first flag and all filter/buffer counters are unchanged by seek itself.

concrete_native_controls.case: Initial mode2 allowance, subsequent read, seek then another read; plus mode0/1 positive request whose native budget is0.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Allowance only under the bound first/policy/availability conjunction. Budget0 returns0 and consumes first; no invented source read or minimum count1.

concrete_native_controls.case: Backend seek mismatch/special code before budget; backend negative read after budget; converter error after backend consumption.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Trace exact calls and flags. Seek failure preserves first; post-budget read failure does not restore first. No output publication on application rejection; converter/backend mutation does not imply rollback.

concrete_native_controls.case: Equal/unequal rate × oldFirst true/false × tell below/equal/above length × actual count short/equal budget.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Unequal-rate flush is end && oldFirst && short; full EOF and later short EOF do not automatically flush. Do not equate a trimmed event end with source EOF.

concrete_native_controls.case: Special-2147483645 once at exact segment start, away from start, repeated special, other negative,0,short,overlong.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Only exact-start special retries once; same buffer/request, no extra seek/reset. Exact positive requested result required.

concrete_native_controls.case: Same actual requested-window sequence reproduced by independent ledger; compare alternative4096/8192/odd sequences as discriminators, not required invariants. High-rate budgets exceeding65408 and unsafe mode1 capacity/terminal windows reject unless exact native internal split is reproduced.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Do not reuse prior full-file fixed8192 count oracle as an accessor-read oracle.

concrete_native_controls.case: Conditional PCM24 half-LSB ties, neighbors, asymmetric clamps and signed zero; nonunity gain on either side of quantization/filter.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Use APP016/accessor-pcm24-oracle-v2.json; neither PCM24 metadata nor passing Float32 kernel controls selects the actual branch.

concrete_native_controls.case: Source/report/media mutation between configurations; same media identity under two native source owners; cancel during producer work, stale completion, restart after rejection.
concrete_native_controls.assert: Proof failure cannot schedule old prepared audio. State sharing follows proven owner, not merely equal file hashes.
